# SOP-P3-L3-02 Product changeover - Machining line
Revision: Rev F — This revision supersedes Rev E  
Plant: P3, line P3-L3  
Equipment: EQ-P3-L3-SB01, EQ-P3-L3-CN02, EQ-P3-L3-HP03

Purpose: Provide standardized steps for product changeover on the machining line to ensure safe, repeatable transitions and maintain part quality.

1. Preconditions
   1.1. Verify previous run complete and parts removed from EQ-P3-L3-SB01 and EQ-P3-L3-CN02.  
   1.2. Confirm maintenance status of EQ-P3-L3-HP03 per SB-1005 and SB-1010.  
   1.3. Confirm tools, fixtures and program files staged for the new product per SOP-P3-L3-04.

2. PPE
   2.1. All personnel must don required PPE before entering the equipment envelope.  
   2.2. Ensure machine guards and interlocks are functional and not bypassed.

3. Mechanical setup
   3.1. Lockout/tagout sequence: follow plant LOTO procedure before any mechanical adjustment.  
   3.2. Check fasteners on fixtures and collars; verify condition of tooling clamping faces.  
   3.3. For Machining hydraulic forging press #3 (EQ-P3-L3-HP03) set main ram bolt to specified torque: The main ram bolt torque for Machining hydraulic forging press #3 (EQ-P3-L3-HP03) is 1600 N·m. Only trained personnel shall apply and record this torque.

4. Lubrication
   4.1. Replenish hydraulic and ram lubrication before first cycle. The lubricant part number for Machining hydraulic forging press #3 (EQ-P3-L3-HP03) is CFW-LUB-254. Use only the specified lubricant.

5. Control and program
   5.1. Load program and verify offsets. Dry-run cycle with guards in place to confirm no interference.

6. Trial run and inspection
   6.1. Run pilot parts and perform dimensional and visual checks. Document disposition per SOP-P3-L3-04.

7. Handover and documentation
   7.1. Complete the changeover checklist and attach to batch record. Reference SB-1005, SB-1010 for maintenance history.

Sign-off
- Operator: ______________________  
- Lead: ______________________  
- Maintenance: ______________________

Related documents: SB-1005, SB-1010, SOP-P3-L3-04
